prompt: A shirt costs \$$40$. It is on sale for $25\%$ off. What is the **sale price**?
hint: A sale takes away part of the price. Decide how many dollars come off before finding what is left to pay.

hints.title: 🔁 Another angle
hints.text: Think of $25\%$ as one quarter. What is one quarter of the shirt's price, and what is left after taking it away?
A sale takes away part of the price. Decide how many dollars come off before finding what is left to pay.
$25\%$ is one quarter, so the discount is $40 \div 4 = 10$ dollars. Take that away from the $40$ dollar price.
$40 - 10 = 30$, so the sale price is $30$ dollars.

explanation: $25\%$ off means one quarter of the price is removed, and one quarter of $40$ is $40 \div 4 = 10$ dollars.
Subtract the discount from the original price: $40 - 10 = 30$.
You can also say you pay $75\%$ of the price, and $0.75 \times 40 = 30$ confirms it.
The sale price of the shirt is $30$ dollars.
